method: Real SGLang FusedMoE TP1/EP1; serialized NVFP4 through production loaders. Identical checkpoints, BF16 inputs and precomputed routes in both arms. Both arms use exact FlashInfer #7290 merge; legacy forces swap_ab=False. Deterministic unfused finalize; no autotuning. W4A16 has an independent dequantized-weight FP32 matmul/BF16-activation reference; W4A4 checks cross-layout parity, graph equality and reload. Optional timings use CUDA events around one whole-forward graph replay per sample, warm L2, initial quantization included, reload/weight prep/capture excluded; fixed defaults are mode-specific, not a fixed-tactic or CUPTI study.
